Use the interpreter /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python; run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`; never pass --cov. Format and lint ONLY with `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format make_case.py tests/test_make_case.py` and `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check make_case.py tests/test_make_case.py` exactly as written (ruff's default settings; this repo has no ruff config). Write NOTES.txt (never committed) with each ambiguity and your choice.

You may edit ONLY: make_case.py and tests/test_make_case.py (new). make_case.py is not yet ruff-clean (one-line imports, semicolons); fixing what ruff reports in it is allowed and expected.

CONTEXT. make_case.py builds a sealed evaluation case from a saved scene report. It copies each replicate's `turns` list unchanged into solver/records.json. Hosted reports will soon carry two engine fields on each turn record: `turn_index` and `turns_since_entry` (the engine's own scene clock after the turn). Older reports do not have them. The clock must NOT be worked out from other record fields: that was tried and gives a wrong answer on hosted reports.

WHAT TO BUILD. (1) In make_case.py, when at least one turn record in the report has an integer `turns_since_entry` (bool is not an integer here), add one top-level key `turns_since_entry_definition` to records.json with exactly this text: "turns_since_entry is the engine's own scene clock read from the game state after the turn: turns played since the player entered the scene named in scene_id (turn_index is the engine's whole-game turn counter). A scene's exit is allowed only once the clock inside that turn reaches the scene's min_turns, so on the turn that changes scene the recorded clock restarts in the new scene and the exit check saw the previous turn's value plus one.". When no turn has it, records.json stays exactly as today (no key, no derived numbers). Never compute, fill in or change `turns_since_entry` or `turn_index`; copy the turn records as today. Keep the rest of make_case's behaviour and output unchanged. (2) TESTS in tests/test_make_case.py, hermetic, under 30 s, using tmp_path and a tiny synthetic report with the same top-level shape make_case reads (`scene`, `replicates` with `replicate`, `scene`, `turns`, `stuck_turns`, `exit_cause`, `ending_reached`); calling main via sys.argv or by refactoring a small helper is fine; the `git archive` of HEAD of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge that main runs is acceptable in a test: (a) turns carrying `turns_since_entry` and `turn_index` -> records.json has the definition text and every turn keeps its values unchanged; (b) turns without them -> no definition key and no added fields; (c) a turn with `turns_since_entry: true` alone does not count.
